What factors affect CRM software cost? CRM pricing refers to the cost of implementing and using customer relationship management software. The price is determined by factors like number of users, features included in the software, integrations and level of support provided by CRM companies. - How much does a CRM cost on average? CRM costs vary widely depending on the CRM company and features included. On average, the typical cost of CRM software ranges from less than a hundred to several hundred dollars per user per year, with some enterprise-level solutions costing even more. To find the best CRM software prices, research and compare CRM providers based on their pricing plans and features. Pipedrive offers different solutions at price points to match users’ requirements. Simply click on your profile in the top right corner of your screen and select “Add more users” from the drop-down menu. - Will my data be safe? Protecting your business data is one of our highest priorities. Learn more about our rigorous security and privacy standards. - What is an add-on? Add-ons are additional Pipedrive tools that you can add to any plan. - What’s the difference between annual and monthly billing? The difference is how often you pay your subscription fee. With monthly billing, you will be charged on the same day each month. With annual billing, you are charged once for the whole year. - Which payment methods do you accept? There are different ways to pay for Pipedrive including major credit cards, debit cards and PayPal. Your payment options depend on the country you live in. - How can I contact customer support? Our friendly support team is ready to help out. Here’s how to get in touch. - What are the prices associated with CRM? As well as the cost of the customer relationship management software itself, which differs based on pricing tier, some providers also charge users for implementation, setup, training, data migration, support and more. You may also be able to purchase credits to get access to more features or more access to the features already on your plan. Try to find a CRM that’s transparent about its pricing. Pipedrive has no hidden costs, making it an excellent choice for anyone with a fixed budget. - What does it cost to implement a CRM? The cost of implementing a CRM varies based on factors such as business size, software choice, user count, customization and integration needs. On-premises setups usually have higher upfront costs. Some CRM providers charge users for implementation. If you choose Pipedrive, implementation is free when you sign up for a pricing plan that’s over $400 a year. title: Knowledge Base
text:
## How does pricing work in Pipedrive?

JT

Jenny Takahara

Last updated: September 3, 2026

Note: Only users with account settings access rights can manage Pipedrive billing. Learn more about user management in this article.

Pipedrive offers four pricing plans to fit teams of any size: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate. You can further customize your subscription with optional add-ons and top-ups.

To view and edit your current subscription, open the account menu in the top-right corner and go to Billing.

---

## Pipedrive plans and billing cycles

To change your plan, click** “Manage subscription”**, then select “All plans” to see all available options.

Once you’ve chosen your plan, select your preferred billing cycle in the same view:

Here’s how the billing cycles differ:

| Billing cycle | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Monthly | You’ll pay on the same day each month |
| Annual | You’ll pay upfront for the entire year and receive a discount |

...

## Add-ons

You can enhance your plan with optional add-ons that provide access to additional tools like prospecting, document management and email marketing. Add-ons are billed according to the billing cycle of your selected plan.

Note: Only Premium and Ultimate plans include some add-ons at no additional cost.

| Add-on | Lite | Growth | Premium | Ultimate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LeadBooster | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |
| Projects | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |
| Smart Docs | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |

...

## What affects your total subscription cost

Your total cost depends on a few key factors:

- Selected plan – Each plan (Lite, Growth, Premium, Ultimate) has its own base price per seat
- Billing cycle – You can choose between annual or monthly billing
- Number of seats – You’re charged per seat, whether it’s assigned to a user or not. Learn more about seats and users.
- Add-ons and top-ups – Optional features and usage extensions that follow your plan's billing cycle
- Currency and location – Your location determines the billing currency and available payment methods

For example, if you’re on the Growth annual plan with four seats and the LeadBooster add-on, your total would be:

4 seats × Growth annual plan price + LeadBooster add-on price
